text: At first Bartleby did an extraordinary quantity of writing. <break time="0.8s" /> As if long famishing for something to copy. <break time="0.8s" /> But he worked on silently, palely, and mechanically. <break time="0.8s" /> Without a trace of cheerful industry. <break time="0.8s" /> On the third day. <break time="0.8s" /> When I called him. <break time="0.8s" /> To examine a short paper with me. <break time="0.8s" /> He replied. <break time="0.8s" /> In a singularly mild, firm voice. <break time="0.8s" /> I would prefer not to. <break time="0.8s" /> Had there been the least uneasiness. <break time="0.8s" /> Anger, or impertinence in his manner. <break time="0.8s" /> I would have dismissed him at once. <break time="0.8s" /> But his face was leanly composed. <break time="0.8s" /> And his gray eye dimly calm. <break time="0.8s" /> A few days later. <break time="0.8s" /> When the four copies of a long document. <break time="0.8s" /> Were ready to be examined. <break time="0.8s" /> I called all my clerks together. <break time="0.8s" /> But Bartleby. <break time="0.8s" /> Appearing at the entrance of his hermitage. <break time="0.8s" /> Calmly preferred not to join us. <break time="0.8s" /> When I demanded his reasons. <break time="0.8s" /> He merely repeated. <break time="0.8s" /> I would prefer not to and, as often happens to a man. <break time="0.8s" /> Resisted in some unprecedented way. <break time="0.8s" /> I began to stagger. <break time="0.8s" /> In my own plainest faith. <break time="0.8s" /> Turning to my other clerks for support. <break time="0.8s" /> I asked their opinion. <break time="0.8s" /> Whereupon Turkey declared. <break time="0.8s" /> In his mild morning voice. <break time="0.8s" /> That I was quite right. <break time="0.8s" /> And Nippers proposed. <break time="0.8s" /> To kick the scrivener out of the office. <break time="0.8s" /> Nothing so aggravates an earnest person. <break time="0.8s" /> As passive resistance. <break time="0.8s" /> Yet, because Bartleby seemed to mean no harm. <break time="0.8s" /> I resolved to construe his strange conduct charitably. <break time="0.8s" /> Rather than to punish it. <break time="0.8s" /> To befriend him. <break time="0.8s" /> I reasoned. <break time="0.8s" /> Would cost me little or nothing. <break time="0.8s" /> While it would lay up in my soul. <break time="0.8s" /> What would eventually prove. <break time="0.8s" /> A sweet morsel for my conscience.
